summary: Tested CheckoutTaskNudge (pre-checkout WhatsApp nudge) on SelfCheckIn page for executive user. All acceptance criteria pass: nudge renders only when checked in, lists urgent/due-today todo with red flame + 'URGENT · DUE TODAY' label, Share to WhatsApp button opens wa.me deep link with correct caption and shows toast, Open Task Manager link navigates to /tasks?tab=todos, and nudge is absent when checked out. No JS/console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutTaskNudge.jsx: on desktop share button always opens WhatsApp Web via popup + copies caption; on browsers blocking window.open the toast still says 'WhatsApp Web opened' — minor UX nit, not blocking.

The nudge also surfaces urgent items from todos_upcoming (future-dated). Copy 'Before you leave' fits due/overdue but may feel odd for a far-future urgent item; consider filtering to due within N days. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created urgent due-today todo 'TEST_Submit regatta report' (id e1d289ae...) via POST /api/todos and deleted it after test. Checked exec user in via /api/attendance/geo-toggle and checked them out again (with DAR text) to restore state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CheckoutTaskNudge is stable. localStorage token key is 'ishowedup_token'. Login UI defaults to phone; email/password requires clicking 'Admin sign in with email' — easier for automation to POST /api/auth/login and inject token into localStorage. DAR (>=20 chars) required on checkout via geo-toggle.
